title: Support single ActivePieces webhook URL with action-based routing for upload vs Ask AI

requirements.text: Allow the app to be configured with a single ActivePieces webhook URL for both file upload processing and Ask AI by supporting the case where VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL and VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL point to the same URL and by providing a fallback so that if only one of these environment variables is set, the app uses the configured one for both actions.

quotes: "I am using one URL for both, but the backend must handle them as two different 'actions' or 'routes.'"

acceptanceCriteria: If only VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL is set (and VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL is empty), file upload and Ask AI requests both use VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL.
If only VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL is set (and VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL is empty), file upload and Ask AI requests both use VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL.
If neither environment variable is set, triggering file upload or Ask AI shows a clear English error message explaining which variable(s) must be set and that one URL may be used for both.
If both variables are set, the existing behavior remains (A used for upload, B used for Ask AI), including the valid case where they are identical.

requirements.text: When calling the single ActivePieces webhook URL, include an explicit action discriminator in the POST request body so the external automation can route the request appropriately: file uploads must send action="process_notes" and expect {summary, quiz_array}; Ask AI must send action="ask_ai" along with user_question and uploaded_notes and expect {ai_answer}.

quotes: "When a file is uploaded, it must return the summary and quiz."
"When a question is asked via the 'Ask AI' button, it must return the ai_answer based on the notes provided in the request body."

acceptanceCriteria: The file upload POST (multipart/form-data) includes a field named "action" with value "process_notes" in addition to the uploaded file.
The Ask AI POST (application/json) includes a field named "action" with value "ask_ai" alongside the existing "user_question" and "uploaded_notes" fields.

The client-side response validation continues to enforce that uploads return a JSON object containing a non-empty "summary" and an array "quiz_array", and Ask AI returns a JSON object containing a non-empty "ai_answer".
User-facing error strings remain in English when response validation fails (e.g., invalid response format).

requirements.text: Update the frontend configuration documentation/template to reflect that a single webhook URL can be used for both actions, while still supporting separate URLs, and ensure all guidance is in English.

quotes: "I am using one URL for both..."

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/.env.example includes English comments instructing that users may set both VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL and VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL to the same webhook URL to use one URL for both actions, or set only one variable if supported by the fallback.
No actual user-provided webhook URL value is committed into frontend/.env.example (it remains a template).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI components).
Do not modify immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor; no new backend services or external databases.
nonGoals: Implementing or modifying the ActivePieces automation/backend logic that interprets the "action" field (this is external to the app).
Adding additional authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
